listen_addresses.description: List of IP addresses on which the Recursor will listen for DNS queries. Empty list means listen on all interfaces.

max_udp_queries_per_connection.description: Maximum number of concurrent UDP queries per connection (for TCP-only setups, typically set to 1).

allow_recursion.description: List of networks or hosts allowed to recurse; set to '0.0.0.0/0' to allow all (not recommended).

log_querylog.description: Enable detailed query logging for troubleshooting.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (none) to 6 (very verbose). Higher values increase log size significantly.

max_concurrent_queries.description: Maximum number of simultaneous queries the recursor will handle.

query_local_address_timeout.description: Timeout (in ms) for determining local address used for outgoing queries.

query_local_address.description: Local source address to use for outgoing queries (e.g., '192.0.2.1'). Empty means use system default.

forward_zones.description: List of zone names (e.g., 'example.com=10.0.0.1') to forward to specific upstream servers. Format: 'zone=upstream1,upstream2'.

forward_timeout.description: Timeout (in ms) for upstream server responses when forwarding.

cache_max_ttl.description: Maximum time-to-live (seconds) for cached entries. Set to 0 to disable caching.

cache_min_ttl.description: Minimum time-to-live (seconds) for cached entries. Use with caution—typically left at 0.

threads.description: Number of worker threads. Set to 0 to auto-detect based on CPU cores.

api_enabled.description: Enable the HTTP API server (requires api-key and api-listen).

api_key.description: Secret API key for HTTP API authentication. Required if API is enabled.

api_listen.description: IP address on which to listen for API connections. Empty string disables API.

remote_pipe_timeout.description: Timeout (ms) for remote control pipe operations.

socket_dir.description: Directory to create control and socket files (e.g., control socket, stats).

max_queries_per_ip_per_second.description: Maximum queries allowed per IP per second before rate-limiting kicks in. Set to 0 to disable.

ecs_ipv4_bits.description: Number of bits of IPv4 client address to preserve in EDNS Client Subnet (0 = disable).

ecs_ipv6_bits.description: Number of bits of IPv6 client address to preserve in EDNS Client Subnet (0 = disable).

ecs_preserve_case.description: If true, preserve case of domain names in ECS queries (RFC 8915).
